# Permissions

Teams has **two** permission layers: normal Drupal (global) permissions, and **per-team** permissions
granted through team roles.

## Global permissions (generated by the entity permission providers)

For `team` (`TeamPermissionProvider`):

| Permission | Grants |
|---|---|
| `administer team` | Team module config + manage any team and team apps (admin_permission). |
| `manage team members` | Manage members/invitations of any team. |
| `view any team` / `create team` / `update any team` / `delete any team` | Standard entity ops on any team. |

For `team_app` (`TeamAppPermissionProvider`):
- `manage team_app` — manage all team apps in the system (constant `MANAGE_TEAM_APPS_PERMISSION`).

For `team_invitation` (`TeamInvitationPermissionProvider`, admin_permission `manage team members`):
standard own/any view/create/update/delete of invitations.

These are assigned on the normal Drupal `People → Permissions` page and apply site-wide.

## Per-team permissions (team roles)

Registered via `apigee_edge_teams.team_permissions.yml` → `DefaultTeamPermissionsProvider`, which
defines these **team permission** names (checked by `TeamPermissionHandler` for the current user *in a
specific team*):

| Group | Permission name | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Team | `team_manage_members` | Add/remove members and administer invitations of the team. |
| Team apps | `team_app_view` | View the team's apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_create` | Create team apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_update` | Edit any of the team's apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_delete` | Delete any of the team's apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_analytics` | View analytics of the team's apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_add_api_key` | Add API keys to team apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_revoke_api_key` | Revoke API keys from team apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_delete_api_key` | Delete API keys from team apps. |
| Team apps | `team_app_edit_api_products` | Edit API products on team apps. |
| API products | `api_product_access_public` | View/assign **public** API products to team apps. |
| API products | `api_product_access_private` | View/assign **private** API products. |
| API products | `api_product_access_internal` | View/assign **internal** API products. |

Other modules can add team permissions by registering their own provider in
`*.team_permissions.yml` (a `DynamicTeamPermissionProviderInterface`).

### Team roles that bundle them (shipped, locked)
- `admin`: `team_manage_members`, `team_app_delete`, `team_app_update`, `team_app_add_api_key`,
  `team_app_edit_api_products`, `team_app_revoke_api_key`.
- `member`: `api_product_access_private`, `api_product_access_public`, `team_app_view`,
  `team_app_create`, `team_app_analytics`.

Every team member implicitly has the `member` role; extra roles are assigned per user per team
(`team_member_role` entity). Manage role definitions at
`/admin/config/apigee-edge/team-settings/permissions` (`TeamPermissionsForm`).
